Welcome to Agent School — lesson eleven.
Here's the twist: pictures can become tokens too.
A multimodal model chops an image into small patches.
Each patch becomes a token — just like a chunk of a word.
Then the same prediction machine reads image tokens and text tokens side by side.
That's how you snap a fridge and ask "what can I cook?" — or show a chart and ask "what's the trend?"
But it can still misread — tiny text, crowded charts, counting objects.
Remember: to AI, everything becomes tokens.
